title: What Happens If You Never Clean Your Dryer Vent?
hook: Stop running your dryer without checking this.

script.narration: Stop running your dryer without checking this.
script.visual_search: pulling thick lint clog from dryer vent

script.narration: Even when you empty the lint trap, tiny fibers still slip into the exhaust hose behind your machine. Over time, that buildup blocks hot air from escaping.
script.visual_search: cleaning lint trap of clothes dryer

script.narration: Clothes take forever to dry, wasting electricity and straining the motor. Worse, trapped lint is highly flammable, so extreme heat can start a fire. Unplug it and vacuum that hose out regularly.
script.visual_search: vacuuming dryer vent hose behind machine

script.narration: Like if this helped, follow for daily home tips. When did you last clean yours? Comment below. To protect your home:

description:
Emptying the lint screen after every load is not enough. Fine lint fibers escape past the trap and build up deep inside your dryer vent hose.

Find out what actually happens when a dryer vent gets clogged—from higher energy bills and longer drying times to serious fire hazards—plus the simple cleaning fix.

Follow Learn in 60 Seconds for fast home maintenance hacks and everyday safety tips.
why_it_will_work: It directly targets active YouTube search demand for how to clean a dryer vent while using the channel's proven urgent warning hook and a clear What-happens-if payoff.
